Catalog of authorization events

Source: R/events.R
aa_events.Rd

The package reports events to the on_event(event, user, session_id, value) hook defined by the application (writing to a log, a messenger notification, etc.). This function returns the full list of events the package can send.

Usage

aa_events(lang = c("en", "ru"))

Arguments

lang

Language of the description and value columns: "en" (default) or "ru".

Value

A data frame with columns event (key), description (what happened) and value (what is in the value field).

Details

The user field in the hook is the login on whose behalf the event happens (for a failed sign-in it is the entered login, and if there is no login, "anonymous"), and value holds the detail described in the value column. Passwords and tokens never appear in events.

Examples

aa_events()
#>                       event
#> 1             login_success
#> 2              login_failed
#> 3              login_locked
#> 4        login_blocked_user
#> 5           login_throttled
#> 6            login_unlocked
#> 7                    logout
#> 8     session_forced_logout

#> 10               user_added

#> 12        user_role_changed

#> 14         sessions_revoked
#> 15           password_reset
